name: create-event
description: Creates a meeting or event in Outlook’s default calendar or a specified calendar. Attendees are sent invitations. microsoft-outlook__find-free-time supplies a free slot, and microsoft-outlook__list-calendars supplies a calendar id.

start.description: ISO 8601 local start date-time without an offset, interpreted in timeZone.

end.description: ISO 8601 local end date-time without an offset, interpreted in timeZone.

timeZone.description: Microsoft Graph time-zone name. Defaults to UTC.

attendees.description: Email addresses of required attendees. Outlook sends them invitations.

isOnlineMeeting.description: Whether to create an online meeting.

isAllDay.description: Whether this is an all-day event.

calendarId.description: Optional calendar ID from microsoft-outlook__list-calendars. If omitted, uses the default calendar.
